# SC-13: It is Monday at 8:00

## Steps
1. Set up: the exceptions list on 2 Mondays of acceptance testing.
2. Then: on 2 Mondays, compare the message with the exceptions list as it stood at 8:00.

## Expected result
The operations manager's phone gets one text message giving the number of orders on the exceptions list (2 cases).
